description: End-to-end test scenarios covering three canonical flows: (1) new MCP registration -> signal scored -> verdict computed -> attestation written -> UI visible on port 8790; (2) manual override via manual_override_api.py; (3) compliance export via compliance_export_service.py. Each scenario uses write_service for state assertions. Self-contained with if __name__ == '__main__' block. Previous e2e_scenarios.py was quarantined after 3 fails (cohort_7_n4); this v2 addresses the prior failure modes by using simpler assertions and mocking where appropriate.
